# Geist

Geist from [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/718e1db4deb9e4d9d85a0ead1b9f5fde2761ccfd/ofl/geist), downloaded September 30, 2026. `Geist-Variable.ttf` is the upstream source, at commit `718e1db4deb9e4d9d85a0ead1b9f5fde2761ccfd`. The font is distributed under the SIL Open Font License in OFL.txt.

Studio embeds static 400, 500, 600 and 700 weight instances made with fontTools 4.66.1. Embedding gives the desktop and web editor the same text metrics without a network font request.

Geist-Numeric.ttf is the 400-weight instance with its ASCII digit cmap entries mapped to Geist's existing `tnum` glyphs. RmlUi's FreeType backend does not apply the OpenType tabular numeral feature. All ten digits have the same advance.

Inter remains available to existing authored game documents. Studio uses Geist and GeistNumeric; code uses JetBrains Mono.
